yt.title: My reflection was one second late all week. Tonight it was one second EARLY 😨 #scary #horror #shorts
yt.description:
All week your reflection blinks a second after you. Tonight, it blinks first.

🎧 headphones on. Don't look at a mirror after this.

#scarystories #horror #3amstories #mirror #shorts

scenes.text: Your reflection has been one second late all week. Tonight, it's one second early.
It's three A.M. You get up for water. The bathroom light is buzzing.
You first noticed it Monday. You'd blink... and it would blink just after.
Tuesday you raised your hand. It waited. Then it raised its hand too.
Tired eyes, you told yourself. Old mirror. Bad light.
But tonight you lean in close. And it blinks before you do.
Wait. If it's not copying you anymore... then who's copying who?
You see, a reflection is like a shadow. It never decides anything. Unless it's been practicing. Your timing. Your face. Your blink.
It's smiling now. You're not. And then you feel your own mouth start to move... to match it.
